back_blurb: Three days on the Big Sur coast road. Walk Cannery Row and drive 17-Mile Drive, stroll storybook Carmel and Point Lobos, then follow Highway 1 past Bixby Bridge to McWay Falls. Where to stay, what to eat, road-status tips and a "Did you know?" at every stop. Practical, checked and pocket-sized.
